_doc: Crafting templates (concept ruling crafting-module-concept §4.4). One engine, N tables: every category repeats the same three-step procedure, so categories 2..N are DATA laps against this same shape (R-CRAFT-1). v1 ships the Brawl & Melee category only. Every value here came from Jason reading the printed book; the corpus OCR of these tables was unusable and seeded NOTHING (R-CRAFT-4). Page cites are PRINTED numbering (corpus runs +3 in this book; calibrated against the book's own cross-references). powered_melee_weapon: OggDude lists three keys (MELEEPOW, MELEEPOWCUT, MELEEPOWBLUD) for this single printed row (Table 3-1, Special Modifications p.76; confirmed via Holocron p.44). The two variant keys differ only by OggDude-private category tags (Cutting Edge Melee / Bludgeoning Melee); all three share identical stats. We hold the single canonical row. OggDude elaborated; we do not (R-CB1, 2026-08-19).
